description: The Tier-0 'live running daemon PROCESS' checks required by verification-architecture.md (PROP-014 in full; PROP-015's part (2); PROP-016's part (2)) cannot yet be TRUE against the actual supervised process, because that process has not been restarted since these files were edited. This is expected and inherent to a pre-restart review (not a code defect in the reviewed diff), but it means PROP-013 (static plist-file check) is the ONLY Tier-0 plist/process check that is actually verifiable right now; PROP-014/015(ii)/016(ii) are unverified until the operational restart happens, and verification-architecture.md itself requires them to be checked immediately after (via `launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/ai.anicca.franklin-loop` and/or `ps eww <pid>`, NOT the verifier's own shell env).
